issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Developer course-attendance API: the problem statement and the template require an instance method named attend(course:) taking Course? (used to implement Developer.attend(course:)), but the solution implements the same behavior under a different identifier participateIn(course:). The solution's Client still calls myself.attend(course:), so the attend(course:) method expected by the template/problem is missing in the solution, which will cause a compilation error and confuses students mapping the requirement to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution method participateIn(course:) to attend(course:) (preferably keeping the same signature Course?) so it matches the problem statement and the template, and keep the existing behavior. Alternatively, add an attend(course:) wrapper that forwards to participateIn(course:) and update any call sites to use one name consistently (Client and tests). Ensure the method signature exactly matches the template (func attend(course: Course?)).
